videos.script: A planner is lists. Sessions in a week, minutes per course, days with something to do. {{arrays}} Arrays first, in order and by position. You will add, remove, and read past the end on purpose, to see what Swift does. {{dict}} Then dictionaries, which look things up by key. You will run one program three times and get three different orders. And sets, for the question: is this one in here? {{mfr}} Then the three methods that replace most loops. Map, filter and reduce. A week of sessions becomes the minutes actually studied, in one line. {{sort}} Sorting, grouping, and finding the longest. {{strings}} Then text, which is a collection too. Counted the way a reader counts, not the way memory stores it. {{lazy}} Last, lazy sequences, which do only the work an answer needs. By the end, the planner can summarise a week per course.
